item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud dregs pa bco brgyad dmag gi zor las dug mda' 'bum 'phros
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan lcags phag lo'i zla tshes nyin par las/ nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon seng gdong phug nas/ rigs ldan karma bde ba'i grogs bcas spyan drangs shing / slar zla tshes la bsod nams stobs kyi rgyal po'i pho brang drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbu rtse nas shog ser bod yig du (tu) phab grub bo//
